This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Haloragis micrantha include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
